subject: general
question:
In this question some of the words sequence is given which follows some logical pattern of word find the next word that can be logically replace the ? In each sequence.

Seed, Sprout, Sapling, ?
solution:
Logic used here:

Stages of plant growth

Seed → initial stage

Sprout → seed begins to grow

Sapling → young plant

Next stage → Tree (fully grown plant)

**∴ The next word is Tree.**
